newsitem.title: UK: Bank of Scotland raises capital.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Scotland raises capital.

text.p: Bank of Scotland Plc said on Wednesday it was raising capital through the placing of 100 million stg nominal of 9-1/4 percent, non-cumulative irredeemable preference stock.
Dealings are expected to start on March 6.
Bank of Scotland said the stock would be issued at a price where the gross yield on issue would be at a margin of 2.25 percent above the gross redemption yield on the 8.0 percent Treasury Stock 2021.
The issue price, which will not be below par, will be determined by 1600 GMT today, Bank of Scotland said.
